The '''Expeditionary Fleet''' was a naval unit of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith]] [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]].

==Description==
The fleet was composed of a dozen [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class]] capital ships and many smaller [[Terminus-class destroyer|''Terminus''-class]] destroyers.

==History==
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], it was under the command of [[Darth Malgus]] and was frequently stationed at [[Vaiken Spacedock]]. Two of its prominent operations include the [[Attack on the Dorin's Sky|attack on the ''Dorin's Sky'']] and the [[Battle of the Foundry]] which led to defeat of the legendary [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and capture of an ancient [[Foundry (space station)|droid factory]].<ref name="TOR:CtA" />

==Behind the scenes==
This fleet is first mentioned in a prelude to [[Hammer Station]] flashpoint<ref name="TOR:HS">{{TORcite|type=flashpoint|Hammer Station}}</ref> and subsequently in other flashpoints introduced to the player by Malgus.<ref name="TOR:CtA" /><ref name="TOR:IFCWG">{{TORcite|type=other|[INTRO] Flashpoint: Colicoid War Game}}</ref> This includes the quest chain for "Call to Arms" that involves a mission against [[Foundry (space station)|The Foundry]] that is under the command of [[Revan/Legends|Revan]].<ref name="TOR:CtA" />
